**Base:** `aaf38e4a0437b20d2ad4191f06cb7368a348f9c7`. **CI source:** Core CI run 37135089404, job API Tests (ubuntu-latest, Python 3.11), on the base commit; EasyOCR not installed (log: 'EasyOCR not available'). **Local source:** Windows 11, Python 3.11.9, EasyOCR 1.7.2; unmodified detached checkout of the base; one test per pytest process; uncommitted call-through probe (no mocks) recording EdgeToDXFResult fields and PeakWorkingSetSize.

## The ~266k observation

**Producer:** the committed Melody Maker PDF, converted by `BlueprintOrchestrator.process_file` (`CleanupMode.ENHANCED`, which reaches `EdgeToDXF.convert_enhanced`) in three tests of `tests/test_text_masking_regression.py` — four conversions per default-CI run, each writing 266,359 `LINE` entities from 743 contours.

Reproduced locally to the entity on the unmasked run (266,359; 684,712 edge pixels; 40,373,932 bytes). The local masked run writes 223,427 because EasyOCR is installed locally and masks text; on CI EasyOCR is absent, masking silently does nothing, and both CI conversions write 266,359 (finding F-3). Counts are identical across every repeat on both platforms; output size varies by at most 1 byte between local runs. The ellipse test is not the producer: it writes 1,116.

## Findings

| ID | Finding | Action in this increment |
|---|---|---|
| F-1 | The default-CI delay is the Melody Maker conversions: 1,148 s of the 1,562 s spanned by test-start timestamps in the Core CI log (73%); next-slowest test 13.4 s. API Verify ran them again (1578.54 s) | separated (marker + dedicated workflow); duplicate conversions removed |
| F-2 | `test_entity_count_reduction` reads `result.entity_count`; `BlueprintResult` has no such attribute (it is `result.dxf.entity_count`), so both counts are 0 and `0 <= 0 + 1000` always passes | recorded; assertion preserved by ruling |
| F-3 | Without EasyOCR, `detect_text_regions` returns `[]`, so `mask_text=True` does no masking and reports SUCCESS; on CI the 'with masking' test is identical to the unmasked one | recorded; production behaviour not changed |
| F-4 | Peak working set about 4.7 GB per conversion and 8.8 GB with both results held (T-06); the shared fixture holds both too | recorded; dedicated lane only |
| F-5 | `VECTORIZER_COMPONENT_LIFECYCLE.md` records `CleanupMode.ENHANCED` as SANDBOX; `VECTORIZER_CANONICAL_PATHS.md` records `enhanced` as PRODUCTION | recorded; not reconciled |
| F-6 | VEC-ROOT-001 §5a states `body_lexicon.md` was never committed; it was committed in vectorizer-sandbox on 2026-09-15 | recorded; merged audit not edited |
| F-7 | The two 128,997-entity Cuatro DXFs are not read by any default-CI test beyond millisecond path enumeration and are unrelated to the delay | none; both retained, ROLE_UNRESOLVED |
